module: Flowgraph node "Set Drag Racer Dial" (category once_instant). Sets the dial (announced time) of one or more drivers. Input pin: dials, table of entries {racerId = number, value = number}. Outputs: flow (pulse), success (all succeeded), count (number of valid dials). Calls dragBridge.setRacersDial.
notes: count is computed before the call: it is the number of valid entries whose racerId exists in dragData.racers.
Empty table: success false, count 0, but flow given.

workOnce.desc: Validates the entries, calls setRacersDial and fills success/count; reports a partial failure through a node error.
